text:
Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
9:04 PM

Here is an easy-paced 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with the long sights early and rest in the afternoons.

Day 1, old city: Arrive and rest. In the evening see Hawa Mahal from outside, walk through Johari Bazaar for sweets and jewellery, and have dinner nearby.
Day 2, forts and palaces: Go to Amer Fort in the morning before the heat, and take a jeep up to skip the steep climb. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal. After a lunch break, visit City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Dinner at Chokhi Dhani is a good folk-style evening.
Day 3, slow day: Visit Govind Dev Ji temple in the morning, then Albert Hall Museum and shopping at Bapu Bazaar for blockprint fabrics and juttis. Add Nahargarh Fort at sunset only if they feel up for it.

Keep the hotel near the old city so the evenings stay short on travel, and book a car with a driver for all three days. Opening hours and entry fees change, so I would confirm them before you go.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:08 PM

National Museum, Delhi (Janpath) is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Tomorrow, Sat 24 Oct, it is open 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an ID card. This is from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page.
